recorded_differences: The returned model has no cached_patcher_init reload factory (the original sets (_reload_gguf_unet, (path, weight_dtype))).
Patch dtype is always the default; the original reads the shared GGMLOps.Linear class, which an earlier ComfyUI-GGUF Advanced load can change (Tier U row D:patch_dtype_leak).
An unknown GGUF name is refused by an existence check in the diffusion-model roots, not by the scanner list; LoRA Manager's extra scanner roots are not searched (existing multi-root gap).
An upper-case '.GGUF' name is refused at queue time; the original lists it (its scanner lower-cases extensions) and then fails at run time in the standard loader.
Error texts name the logical file, never a host path (the original's 'Could not detect model type ...: <absolute path>').

The text after the shared wrapper carries the host exception's type name, e.g. "Failed to load GGUF diffusion model 'x.gguf': ValueError: Unexpected architecture type ..." where the original has no 'ValueError: '. The secure transport reports a host failure to the guest as '<Type>: <message>' (backend a1 transport/wire.py:157); stripping it would tie the port to a non-public transport attribute (Tier U r2 attempt 2 diagnosis).
